title: DiaLLM: An Investigation into the Robustness-Generation Gap in English Dialect Adaptation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness and generative capabilities on non-standard English varieties (Australian, Indian, and Northern British English) using dialect-specific benchmarks (DIALECTBENCH, VALUE, BESSTIE), surface dialectal feature detectors, and human/LLM-as-a-judge preference evaluations to measure disparities compared to standard English.
